disease_state: The development of leptomeningeal melanoma metastases (LMM) is a rare and devastating complication of the late-stage disease, for which no effective treatments exist.
sample_source: Forty-five human CSF specimens from 16 patients were procured under written informed consent in accordance with the Belmont Report and the Declaration of Helsinki.
anatomic_site_tumor: As cells that are metastatic to the leptomeninges exist within the CSF space, serial sampling of CSF via lumbar puncture or the Ommaya reservoir offers a unique opportunity to track how the tumor microenvironment is changing during tumor progression and in response to therapy.
